generalAbilities.name: Mistvision
generalAbilities.description: A sapient purple orb always ignores concealment caused by fog, smoke, and mist.

offensiveAbilities.name: Astral Mist
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect The sapient purple orb emits a red mist (as the spell) centered on themself. Sapient orbs can choose to emit transparent mist, granting no concealment. Allies and Fascinated creatures in the mist gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws. Additionally, any enemy that's in the mist when it appears, that enters the mist, or that ends its turn in the mist must attempt a DC 21 Will Saving Throw save unless it's fascinated.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes fascinated by the mist.

Critical Failure The creature becomes fascinated by the mist and Stunned 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Excandescent Flash
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect The sapient purple orb momentarily increases their luminance to an aggressively bright spectrum. Each other creature within 20 feet that can see the sapient purple orb must succeed at a DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw saving throw or be Dazzled for 1d4 rounds. On a critical failure, the target instead becomes Blinded for 1 round, then dazzled for 1d4 rounds.

cantrips.name: Daze
cantrips.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also Stunned 1.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

cantrips.name: Figment
cantrips.description:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to Create a Diversion with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

Spell Effect: Figment

cantrips.name: Seek the Stars
cantrips.description:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.

cantrips.name: Telekinetic Hand
cantrips.targets: 1 unattended object of light Bulk or less
cantrips.description:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

cantrips.name: Telekinetic Projectile
cantrips.description:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

lv2spells.name: Mind Skewer
lv2spells.description:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also Stupefied 2 for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

lv2spells.name: Soothe
lv2spells.description:
You grace the target's mind, boosting its mental defenses and healing its wounds. The target regains 1d10+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and gains a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects for the duration.

Spell Effect: Soothe

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d10+4.

lv2spells.name: Telekinetic Maneuver
lv2spells.description: With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to Disarm, Shove, Reposition, or Trip the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

lv2spells.name: Translate
lv2spells.description:
The target can understand the meaning of a single language it is hearing or reading when you cast the spell. This doesn't let it understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). If the target can hear multiple languages and knows that, it can choose which language to understand; otherwise, choose one of the languages randomly.

Heightened (3rd) The target can also speak the language.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures, and targets can also speak the language.
